runtime.name: Joi
runtime.note: Routing selects a locally trained neural model. Names and reply text are not substituted by a template.

protocol.stop: first generated newline; turn marker is removed

note: Development probes, not an independent test set. Each episode uses the model's actual earlier replies. Literal name/topic checks do not establish reliable memory, fluency or cheerfulness.
